name: io.github.jhonattan-souza/dotnet-agents-caldav
description: CalDAV MCP for Calendars, Events, To-dos, free/busy, collection sync, and metadata updates.

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_URL
environmentVariables.description: Absolute CalDAV server endpoint or Calendar Home URL

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_AUTH_SCHEME
environmentVariables.description: CalDAV HTTP authentication scheme: basic (default) or bearer (optional)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for CalDAV Basic authentication; required for basic and must be omitted for bearer

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for CalDAV Basic authentication, or the static token for bearer

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_CALENDAR_HREFS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact canonical Calendar href allowlist (optional; omit to discover every Calendar)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_DEFAULT_TODO_CALENDAR_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name of the default Calendar for To-do operations (optional)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_DEFAULT_EVENT_CALENDAR_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name of the default Calendar for Event operations (optional)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_EVALUATION_TIME_ZONE
environmentVariables.description: Explicit IANA time zone used as the configured Temporal Evaluation Context for bounded Calendar Entity Starts and every Occurrence or To-do Start, including To-do queries without a window

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_INTEROPERABILITY_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Verified server runtime profile; radicale-3.7.8 enables server-authoritative MOVE and its native free/busy representation (optional)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_SCHEDULING_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Scheduling model: storage_only (default) blocks participant writes and collection deletion on auto-scheduling servers; server_managed allows them and discloses that the server may send invitations or cancellations (optional)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_REDIRECT_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated HTTPS host allowlist for cross-origin redirects and discovered hrefs, such as .icloud.com; exact host names or leading-dot strict-subdomain suffixes that receive the configured credentials at the configured port (optional; omit to stay same-origin)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_EXPOSE_EXACT_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose protected exact Calendar Object Resource tools (optional)

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: OTLP collector endpoint; a non-empty value opts into telemetry export

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: Standard OTLP transport protocol, such as http/protobuf or grpc (optional)

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Optional OTLP authentication or routing headers

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Telemetry service name override; defaults to dotnet-agents-caldav

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SDK_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to disable the OpenTelemetry SDK even when an endpoint is configured
